title: Plan amendment: convergence loop replaces the single re-translation step
description:
As the planner, I want the multilingual plan to describe the convergence loop, so the plan and the procedure say the same thing.

Amend docs/plans/multilingual-publishing.md (plan PR #1450, merged) as follows. This story is the record; do not edit the plan file from the design session.

- Step 6, today a single re-translation, becomes the convergence loop: the check stages repeat on changed blocks only while a round strictly reduces the weighted findings and adds no faithfulness finding; a block whose rewrite makes faithfulness worse reverts to its previous text; the loop ends when a round changes nothing or makes no progress. The hold condition (an error-severity faithfulness finding that remains) is unchanged.
- Copy-edit rewriting moves inside that loop: the machine may rewrite its own translation (machine-owned blocks), each rewrite re-checked against the English source; human-corrected blocks keep advice only.
- Evaluation: replace the panel-based evaluation with automated measures only and state that nobody in-house can verify Chinese quality (Ryan 2026-11-13).
- Record Ryan's other decisions of 2026-11-13: stock phrasing reported back on the English Story; target-locale conventions through the per-language glossary and pack, never omitting or altering a factual claim; a rule may drive rewrites at about 9 in 10 correct on held-out examples per language; Spanish and Chinese packs built together.

```gherkin
Feature: The plan matches the procedure
  Scenario: Step 6 is the convergence loop
    Given the multilingual publishing plan
    When a reader looks for what happens after the translation is checked
    Then the plan describes the convergence loop and its stop rule
    And it no longer describes a single re-translation

  Scenario: The plan has no native-reader panel
    Given the multilingual publishing plan
    Then its evaluation uses automated measures only
    And says plainly that nobody in-house can verify Chinese quality
```
